description: Constellation Energy Corporation is a Pennsylvania corporation that became an independent, publicly traded company in February 2022 when Exelon completed the separation of its competitive generation and customer-facing energy businesses, conducted through Constellation and its subsidiaries, by distributing all outstanding shares of the company's common stock on a pro rata basis to the holders of Exelon's common stock, with the company holding all the interests in Constellation previously held by Exelon. It describes itself as the nation's largest producer of clean and reliable energy and, following the Calpine merger, the largest private-sector power producer in the world, and it has five reportable segments representing the different geographic regions in which its owned generating resources are located and its customer-facing activities are conducted, including Mid-Atlantic, Midwest, New York and ERCOT.
